svg.title: Casa em Movimento
svg.desc: Ilustração original do desafio Casa em Movimento.
svg.metadata: {"generator": "image_gen built-in", "prompt": "Use case: illustration-story. Use the attached artwork ONLY as a STYLE and CHARACTER REFERENCE: reproduce its polished detailed pixel-art rendering, crisp small pixels, beautiful dimensional lighting, cozy Brazilian indie adventure atmosphere and the SAME Black teenage heroine with dark brown skin, voluminous short curly afro hair, lavender purple jacket, cream shirt, navy trousers and white-soled sneakers. Create ONE entirely new finished game-selection cover for another VOICES challenge, replacing the whole scene and pose. Wide landscape 20:9 aspect ratio (approximately 1870x841), edge-to-edge artwork for a 640x288 card. Professional rich 16-bit pixel-art key art with readable silhouettes, nuanced dithering, layered scenery and strong focal hierarchy, not generic chunky rectangles. NO text, lettering, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, HUD, borders, screenshots, photorealism or smooth vector art. All key action should stay within the central 75 percent height for panoramic composition. Challenge: Casa em Movimento. A beautiful cozy room decorating puzzle viewed from an elevated three-quarter angle with the roof removed. The heroine is carefully placing a lush potted fern directly beside a terracotta upholstered sofa, making object placement the central action. Clearly visible furnishings include a pale wooden side table with an open book resting ON it, a small framed picture hanging ABOVE a table on a sage wall, a blue-paned window, woven rug and books. Lovely wood floorboards with a subtle small arrangement of tile-like spaces near the movable fern, not a wall of UI. Warm honey afternoon window light, cozy sage, dusty lavender, terracotta and cream. Detailed fabric, ceramic pots, leaves and book spines. Composed like an inviting handcrafted pixel-art dollhouse, sophisticated and readable, with no roof blocking the objects. No text, arrows, rulers or interface panels."}
